newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Turkmenistan gets $64.5 mln World Bank loan.
newsitem.headline: Turkmenistan gets $64.5 mln World Bank loan.

text.p: The World Bank approved a $64.5 million loan, repayable in 20 years, to the Central Asian republic of Turkmenistan, the bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
The statement said $34.2 million would be used to finance an Urban Transport Project in Ashghabat, Mary and Chardjou.

The remaining $30.3 million would fund a Water Supply and Sanitation Project in the Dashkhovuz Velayet, the region of Turkmenistan most severely affected by the environmental crisis of the Aral Sea basin.
